questions.source: JC69 simulation (truth.py) on a random 24-taxon tree; the asked taxon's cherry partner in the generating tree

questions.question: The file `trees.nwk` in the current working directory holds two phylogenies of the same 38 taxa in Newick, one per line (tree A, then tree B). questions.answer_format: an integer, e.g. 6
questions.source: truth.splits on both Newick strings as written
